faq_heading: Cottonwood condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Cottonwood. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Cottonwood, Maple Ridge: 36 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 3 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Cottonwood fell from 43 in June to 36 in October (−16.3%), and 34 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 13.4% of Maple Ridge’s 268 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Cottonwood?
Cottonwood also had 46 houses listed and 10 sold in October, against 36 condos and townhomes listed. The Cottonwood houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Cottonwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

75 townhomes sold in Cottonwood with a median price of $750,000 (the middle half sold between $716,200 and $830,500), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $484 per square foot, a median year built of 2015 and a median strata fee of $373 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Cottonwood?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 36 condos and townhomes listed in Cottonwood. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cottonwood a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Cottonwood had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Cottonwood from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 34 condos and townhomes sold in Cottonwood over those 5 months, out of 230 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Cottonwood sell for?
faq.a: 75 townhomes sold in Cottonwood between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $750,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Cottonwood?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.9% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
